source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

parts.target: A **GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY** unit of yours.
parts.effect:
If every model of the unit has **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)**, the unit leaves the battlefield and goes into **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**.

This works even if the unit is in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of enemy units, and on top of the units removed with [Gate of Infinity](vsdata:ability/grey-knights.gate-of-infinity).

data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), as it ends.

**Target:** A **GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY** unit of yours.

**Effect:** If every model of the unit has **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)**, the unit leaves the battlefield and goes into **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**.

This works even if the unit is in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of enemy units, and on top of the units removed with [Gate of Infinity](vsdata:ability/grey-knights.gate-of-infinity).

effects.condition: every model in the unit has the Deep Strike ability

detail.designerNote: Usable in addition to units removed with the Gate of Infinity rule, and on a unit within Engagement Range of enemy units.
